Path 3, data protectionGOALS §8

Velero

Backup and restore for cluster resources and volumes.

WHAT IT IS

A CNCF tool that backs up Kubernetes resources and persistent volumes to object storage, with scheduled backups, CSI snapshots, and restore into the same or a different cluster.

WHAT SETS IT APART

The project update headline: faster backups, consistent snapshots, incremental everything. Versus Kasten: open source, but less app-aware. A Data Protection WG is standardising what's underneath.

WHERE WE STAND

Adopt, and put restore drills on the calendar: a backup nobody has restored is a hope.

Velero project update (Red Hat); Kubernetes Data Protection WG, KubeCon NA 2026

ADOPT

Velero: Backup and restore for cluster resources and volumes. Where we stand: Adopt, and put restore drills on the calendar: a backup nobody has restored is a hope. Pair with reclaimPolicy Retain on stateful storage classes: the storage layer is the first line, backups the second.
